content: C.E.O. is out now: https://Weezer.lnk.to/CEO The new album, Weezer, arrives August 21st: https://Weezer.lnk.to/Weezer Many thanks to our distinguished associates for their appearances in the accompanying visual presentation. Each has been awarded the Gold Star of Excellence for exemplary performance. Recipients: Tony Hawk, Curry Barker, Dax Flame, Chit (aka Jay Renshaw), Rob Riggle, Rob Huebel, Michael Peña, Giovanni Ribisi and Christopher Mintz-Plasse. Pat yourselves on the back for helping to raise the gold standard. Regards, The C.E.O. Weezer Enterprises IMPORTANT TOUR ANNOUNCEMENT: New international gathering sites across the UK, Europe and Japan have been discovered. Further details including dates and tickets are on https://weezer.com/tour Carry it with you to the Gathering, and witness what follows.
